genres.json: dubstep.name: Dubstep, modern (2015-2026), original mix
genres.json: dubstep.status: researched 2026-11-25 (queue item 12); target measured from the open catalogue; loudness untested in the engine
genres.json: dubstep.target_source: MusicBrainz tag dubstep, first release 2015-2021, up to 300 per year; AcousticBrainz low-level Bark bands (CC0)

era_targets.note: the master uses `target`; a brief aimed at an era or strand passes `--target` (docs/DUBSTEP.md 'Mastering per subdivision')

master_by_strand.note: loudness varies by strand more than by year since 2015 (whole tracks: riddim -7.6, brostep -8.7, melodic -9.3, all dubstep 2015-21 -10.3; loud sections of current releases -6, Mixgraph previews); pass the flags with --genre dubstep and check the loudest 2 minutes; none of these levels has been tested in the engine
master_by_strand.riddim, tearout, briddim: --target dubstep_riddim --lufs -7 --tp -1 (only with clipped drum and bass buses; riddim curve from 81 tracks)
--lufs -8.5, then read the drop's short-term loudness; lower --lufs rather than let a quiet outro push the drops harder

genres.json: dubstep.length: 3:30-4:30, aim about 3:50-4:00 (original mix; measured: tag dubstep median 4:06 in 2014-16, 4:02 in 2017-19, 3:42 in 2020-21 (middle half 3:15-4:21), 4:33-4:36 in 2008-13; riddim 3:39, melodic dubstep 4:18)
genres.json: dubstep.form: intro 8-32 bars (the drop near bar 32), build 8 (a 4-bar false drop optional), drop 1 16-32 bars in 8-bar halves with a switch at the half, breakdown or mid-section 8-16, build 8, drop 2 16-32 bars that differs from drop 1 (new drums, new bass or another strand), outro 8-16
genres.json: dubstep.tempo: 140-150 bpm felt in half time (70-75); catalogue median 140 every year 2006-2018, 148 in 2019, 145 in 2020-21; riddim 145; Mixgraph median 145 (140-150), peak 150 in 2017; 140 for deep / 140 and colour bass, 145-150 for riddim, tearout and much melodic dubstep
genres.json: dubstep.meter: 4/4 written at 140-150, kick on 1, snare (clap + snare) on 3; swung 16ths in the UK strands, triplet percussion in riddim, grid-tight in tearout
genres.json: dubstep.change_rate: something every 4-8 bars; a switch at the half of each drop (8 bars) in brostep and tearout; riddim holds one motif through a drop and changes it only by modulation
genres.json: dubstep.role: the bass is the lead: a mid-bass voice (or two in call and response) carries the hook; voices as chopped, pitched phrases and pre-drop calls
hand_tuned: lufs -8 (and the strand levels -7 / -8.5 / -10): choices between measured whole-track medians and the -6 loud previews; untested in the engine
mono_below 150 (inside the sourced 150-180 Hz side cut)
genres.json: dubstep.sources: docs/DUBSTEP.md 'Configuration', 'Catalogue measurements' and 'Mastering per subdivision' (Mixgraph dubstep BPM https://www.mixgraph.io/bpm-for/dubstep ; Mixgraph loudness by genre https://www.mixgraph.io/tools/lufs-meter ; catalogue lengths, tempo, loudness and curves by Spectre from MusicBrainz + AcousticBrainz, 2026-11-25; EDMProd, Cymatics, Futureproof, Infekt, iZotope/Skrillex 2011 for form, drums and mixing)

eqmaps.json: dubstep.source: docs/DUBSTEP.md 'Layering and EQ carving': Cymatics, EDMProd, Futureproof mixing, iZotope (Skrillex 2011), Mixgraph; lead/pluck/pad rows from the trance and hip-hop maps [H]
